recipes.name: Hero hold
recipes.description: A locked composition with room for the product to breathe.

recipes.name: Elevated hold
recipes.description: A raised three-quarter view for the top and front surfaces.

recipes.name: Gentle push
recipes.description: Move from context toward the product at a measured pace.

recipes.name: Detail push
recipes.description: A longer approach that brings the product details forward.

recipes.name: Context pull
recipes.description: Begin close and open up the surrounding scene.

recipes.name: Wide pull
recipes.description: A longer departure into the surrounding space.

recipes.name: Left slide
recipes.description: Track left while keeping the product in the composition.

recipes.name: Right slide
recipes.description: Track right with a consistent look at the product.

recipes.name: Quarter orbit
recipes.description: Trace a curved approach around the front of the product.

recipes.name: Reverse orbit
recipes.description: Trace the same arc in the opposite direction.

recipes.name: Left reveal
recipes.description: Slide from an angled opening into the hero view. Foreground occlusion must be arranged and checked separately.

recipes.name: Right reveal
recipes.description: Slide from the other side into the hero view. Foreground occlusion must be arranged and checked separately.

limitations: Recorded development outcomes only; no model calls, plan recompilation or current-checker regrading.
Criterion denominators are credited returned plans. Compilation failures have separate observed compile/task denominators; codes overlap.
Logged schema errors and compile checks are observed counts, not proof that omitted actions were valid. A provider-call/event count gap does not identify omitted action types or causes.
Engine validity is conditional on supplied synthetic geometry and is not physical safety or brief preservation.
A valid intermediate compile is not a graded final plan and receives no productive credit. Raw library fallback plans do not receive model-success credit.
Witness absence is unresolved, not proof of infeasibility. Twelve scene groups contain dependent movement tasks.
This attempt is separate from the initial GPT network pilot, failed warmups, other arms, and future confirmation.
Diagnosis does not establish creator benefit or authorize tuning the frozen candidate.
